author: dilpickel
body:
Hello dilpickel here and I bring you my second map!

Sketch Vapor!

Map Name: Sketch Vapor
Map Gamemode: Nebula DTM.
Map Creator: dilpickel.

Intro:
In this map players will have to work together to defend the monument and hold back the apposing force. Enchant your gear with the enchanting tables to get a advantage on others. Careful of the cactus they prick!

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/z0m6cravnugrbru/SketchVapor.zip
Separate yaml: http://pastie.org/private/8qfybpbhcvb5dsxrv1qgma

Info: (per island).
19 diamond blocks.
2 large main platforms.
1 monument. 
2 piles of iron.
1 enchanting table.
1 water.


Teams are 20v20.

ADDED: More cover, more iron, one diamond block, fixed up monument room, extended spawn.
REMOVED: 
Here's some pictures:
http://imgur.com/a/La45f (more pics).

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
Wonderful! I've never seen anything like this map, I absolutely love the actual layout of the map, Very unique! It's lovely the way you incorporated the various blocks to serve as obstacles, and floor patterns.

One thing I do not agree with is your monuments. They are way too separate from the rest of your map, and it seems that they would be quite hard to mine. Possibly a couple buildings here and there may make the map a tad better. I do not believe this should be accepted just yet, but I do not believe it should be denied either. Lots of potential, just needs a few revisions!
